{{Top|leg}}
'''Krabbis Inn''' was an under-plaza hostel near the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It provided accommodations to tourists at cut-rate prices.<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> 

In [[43 ABY]], a short [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|skirmish]] ensued on the inn when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to spy on the [[New Jedi Order]] were discovered by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="abyss" />
